mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password, created_at, updated_at, login_type) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{password}, NOW(), NOW(), 'LOCAL')
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role AS role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
